checks: Sixteen distinct layouts, three environments, staged package queues and finite budgets
Every original structure stays exactly stable for five seconds with no free delivery
Ready is frozen and refuses launch or ability; parameters must be finite and in range
One launch consumes one parcel and an active flight rejects repeated or stale launch
Standard parcel has no ability and keys cannot create another parcel
Sail activates once, adds forward lift and lowers gravity for its finite window
Heavy seal activates once, adds downward impulse and stronger impact without an explosion
Short preview spans only .45 seconds and matches ordinary free flight within integrator error
Swept rectangle faces and rounded corners catch high-speed paths through thin obstacles
A real fixed-step projectile cannot tunnel through a solid stone wall
Repeated contact delivers each target ID and stamp only once
A falling intact block can deliver after the last parcel is gone, and loss waits for collapse
Last parcel missing all stations settles to one loss, rather than losing at launch
Moving structures and flight lock another launch until a quiet settling interval
Pause freezes projectile, structures, debris, budget, score, timer and all commands
60Hz and 120Hz frame partitions use the same fixed-step trajectory and structures
In-flight refresh replay preserves the exact ability and full physical state
Pending real-play collapse is exactly restored instead of resetting the structures
Bad, null, impossible, duplicate and ended checkpoints reject forged state
Fragments are bounded decorative pieces, expire, and cannot deliver or score
All sixteen recorded normal-budget plans replay with distinct win and full-star results
An ordinary first-stage shot earns all three stars without setting stamps or targets
Stars and score distinguish delivery, par and optional stamps; loss never awards stars
Observation guard settles once with an accurate reason rather than claiming ammo ran out
Diagnostics snapshots never mutate the live model or immutable level layouts
fixture: Explicit isolated collision/last-ammo/falling-block/star unit fixtures alone assign test-world state. All sixteen production campaigns, replay and real browser tests use ordinary launch/ability and formal fixed-step updates only.
